items.title: A theme preset for each page subtree
items.description: Any page subtree can now use its own shadcn theme preset. Subpages inherit it, and it switches at runtime, so campaign pages can run Midnight while the rest stays on Aurora.

items.title: Rebuild the full demo site at any time
items.description: The styleguide and starter seeders are now services with functional tests. The command is safe to repeat and works in workspaces, so run it after each upgrade.

items.title: Friendly Captcha placeholder fallback
items.description: Forms with Friendly Captcha now show a demo placeholder when no site key is set. Seeded demo sites no longer show a broken form.

items.title: Strict Fluid 5 components without Alpine.js
items.description: All components now use strict Fluid 5 ViewHelpers in the d: namespace. Plain JavaScript replaces the Alpine.js runtime. Update your custom templates before you upgrade.
